items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: a couple of other guys play. Rashawn Ross, who plays with Dave Mathews — so you know it’s still called the Jerry Hey Horns

ctx.x: Is it tough for you over the years to, you want to send in the Jerry Hey Horns so does that mean that you have to get on the phone with all the members every time you get called for a recording session? To see that they could all make it?

Well you know Gary Grant is not playing anymore so you know he was like a key member of the horn section. Bill Reichenbach has moved to near Asheville, North Carolina, and he’s also another, was a key member. He comes back to play on movies now. He does all the John Williams’ movies and plays on movies but he’s not always here when I do a session. And Larry Williams, who is still playing saxophone but because of a lot of times it’s baritone saxophone now and Dan Higgins plays everything amazingly well so he’s…
I’m sure it’s excellent, and it’s a blessing to have that group of musicians who you’d have to go out of your way to get someone who wasn’t cutting it.
